description: Implement Google Sign-In authentication with Supabase, including Gmail scope access and session persistence

userStories.title: Create Supabase Project
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Supabase project configured so that I have a backend for authentication and data storage.
acceptanceCriteria: Supabase project created at supabase.com
Project URL and anon key obtained
.env.local file created with EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
.env.local added to .gitignore
.env.example created with placeholder values for documentation
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Manual step - requires creating project at supabase.com

userStories.title: Create Google OAuth Credentials
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Google Cloud OAuth credentials so that users can sign in with Google.
acceptanceCriteria: Google Cloud project created or existing project used
OAuth consent screen configured with app name and scopes
iOS OAuth client ID created with correct bundle ID
Web OAuth client ID created (required for expo-auth-session)
Client IDs added to .env.local: EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID, EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID
.env.example updated with Google credential placeholders
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Manual step - requires Google Cloud Console access

userStories.title: Initialize Supabase Client
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a configured Supabase client so that the app can communicate with the backend.
acceptanceCriteria: services/supabase.ts file created
Supabase client initialized with URL and anon key from environment
AsyncStorage configured for session persistence
autoRefreshToken and persistSession options enabled
TypeScript types exported for Database (placeholder initially)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create Auth Context and Hook
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an auth context so that authentication state is accessible throughout the app.
acceptanceCriteria: contexts/AuthContext.tsx file created
Context provides: user, session, isLoading, signIn, signOut
hooks/useAuth.ts created as convenience hook
Context listens to Supabase auth state changes via onAuthStateChange
Loading state is true until initial session check completes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement Google Sign-In Flow
userStories.description: As a user, I want to sign in with my Google account so that I can access the app.
acceptanceCriteria: services/auth/google-auth.ts file created
Uses expo-auth-session Google provider
Requests scopes: openid, email, profile, gmail.readonly, gmail.send, gmail.modify
Requests offline access (access_type: offline) for refresh token
On success, creates or updates user in Supabase Auth using signInWithIdToken
Google access/refresh tokens stored in Supabase user metadata
Returns Supabase session to app
Verify on device: Tapping Continue with Google opens Google OAuth flow
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Update Sign-In Screen with Real Auth
userStories.description: As a user, I want the sign-in button to actually authenticate me.
acceptanceCriteria: app/sign-in.tsx updated to use useGoogleAuth hook
Loading state shown while auth is in progress
Error handling with user-friendly message on failure
On success, navigation handled by auth state change (not manual redirect)
Verify on device: Sign in completes and user proceeds to next screen
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement Protected Routes
userStories.description: As a user, I should be redirected to sign-in if not authenticated, and to feed if authenticated.
acceptanceCriteria: app/_layout.tsx wrapped with AuthProvider
Root layout checks auth state before rendering routes
Unauthenticated users redirected to /sign-in
Authenticated first-time users go to /onboarding (check AsyncStorage flag)
Authenticated returning users go to /(tabs) feed
Splash or loading screen shown during auth check
Verify on device: Fresh app launch shows sign-in. After sign-in shows onboarding or feed.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement Sign Out
userStories.description: As a user, I want to sign out so that I can switch accounts or secure my session.
acceptanceCriteria: Sign out button added to settings or profile area
Calling signOut clears Supabase session
User redirected to sign-in screen after sign out
Google tokens cleared from user metadata
Verify on device: Tapping sign out returns to sign-in screen
Typecheck passes
